activity.role: Chief, medicine man and war leader
activity.notes: Iron Jacket was a documented Comanche chieftain and medicine man. Because surviving sources do not establish a secure accession date or unified political jurisdiction, ATLAS records the well-attested 1858 war-leadership context culminating in his death in battle on 12 May 1858 rather than inventing a multi-year sovereign reign.

sources.title: Iron Jacket — Handbook of Texas
sources.citation_text: The Texas State Historical Association identifies Iron Jacket as a Comanche chieftain and medicine man and records his death in battle on 12 May 1858.
